comparison.excerpt: Relative to the group with low urinary iodine, the age-adjusted hazard ratio was higher (although marginally insignificant) in the moderate group

confidence_interval.excerpt: Relative to the group with low urinary iodine, the age-adjusted hazard ratio was higher (although marginally insignificant) in the moderate group, hazard ratio 1.33 (95% confidence interval 1.00-1.78), and significantly lower in the high group, 0.71 (0.51-0.99).

continent.excerpt: data from the NHANES I Epidemiologic Follow-up Study

design.excerpt: We investigated iodine status and prostate cancer risk prospectively using data from the NHANES I Epidemiologic Follow-up Study.

effect_size.excerpt: Relative to the group with low urinary iodine, the age-adjusted hazard ratio was higher (although marginally insignificant) in the moderate group, hazard ratio 1.33 (95% confidence interval 1.00-1.78), and significantly lower in the high group, 0.71 (0.51-0.99). Thyroid disease was associated with an increased prostate cancer risk, 2.34 (1.24-4.43).

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Participants were stratified into tertiles according to the urinary iodine/creatinine ratio, as a marker of iodine exposure.
